title: SEDAP-Express REST API v1.5.0
description: JSON Schema for the SEDAP-Express REST API request and response envelopes. The SEDAP-Express message itself is transported as its original semicolon-separated string.

MessageCollection.title: MessageCollection
MessageCollection.description: Container for one or more SEDAP-Express messages.

messages.description: List of SEDAP-Express messages; different message types may be mixed.

SedapExpressMessage.title: SedapExpressMessage
SedapExpressMessage.description: A complete SEDAP-Express message in its original semicolon-separated representation.

message.description: Complete SEDAP-Express CSV message. If a MAC is present, calculate it over the complete serialized message with the MAC field empty, retaining the field position and delimiters. Do not include the received MAC value or a placeholder in the calculation.

SuccessResponse.title: SuccessResponse
SuccessResponse.description: Response indicating whether the request was processed successfully.

success.description: Success indicator represented as a string.
